Commentary.Commentary: Right then, that is all we have from this game. The action in the T20 World Cup however, will continue on 28th October as Australia will take on Sri Lanka in Dubai for game number 22. That match starts at 6 pm local time (2 pm GMT) but the build up will start earlier. Do join us for that one. Till then, cheers!

The winning skipper, Gerhard Erasmus says, they are obviously delighted to get another win in the World Cup. Mentions the boys did well and executed the plan to get over the line. Adds they will take good momentum from this game. On being asked about the plan in the break, he says, they speak more before the game and then on the field they aim to back themselves. Adds, the celebrations will be quite big this time as well.

The losing captain, Richie Berrington says, that they were 20-30 runs short. Mentions that it was pretty hard to recover after the first over. Tells that they needed a partnership to get going and Cross and Leask played really well but could not get going. Adds that they don't have time to thing about it too much and they will just focus on their next game and put this loss behind. Ends by saying that they will take their learning from this game and come back stronger in the next game. On Kyle, he says that he is resting now and they will have to check if he is fit and available for the next game.

Ruben Trumpelmann has been awarded the MAN OF THE MATCH for his exceptional figures of 4-0-17-3! He says, it is a great result for the team. Mentions the preparation has been good in the past few days and he enjoyed his time out in the middle. It’s the World Cup, so why not. Adds that he uses swings upfront and it paid off really well. Ends by saying, it’s a good win and the boys will surely celebrate it.
... PRESENTATION ...

Earlier in the day, Gerhard Erasmus won the toss and put Scotland into bat. His decision was complimented straightaway by Ruben Trumpelmann who picked up three wickets in the very first over. This set the tone for the innings and Namibia restricted their opponents to 109. The Namibian openers put a few runs on the board and after some hiccups along the way, JJ Smit finished things off in style and Namibia have two points on board. It's time for the presentation ceremony...

Scotland almost pulled the rabbit out of the hat but there just weren't enough runs to defend. The pacers started off nicely with the ball, allowing no room to the Namibian batters to get ahead in the game but managed just one wicket in the Powerplay. Once Zane Green fell, the Scottish spinners started to pile on the pressure. Michael Leask was the pick of the bowlers as he picked up a couple of wickets and Mark Watt and Chris Greaves picked up a wicket each. Scotland took the game into the final over and this shows character. They lose their second game in a row but won't be disappointed with their bowling effort.

Namibia have been missing from the biggest stage of cricket for the past 18 or so years and here they are now, in the Super 12 of the T20 World Cup and they have just won their first match. The total to chase down was a low one but it's always the totals that require around run-a-ball that play with the mind and that's what happened to Namibia but a few partnerships here and there and a flourish in the end means Namibia continue their red hot streak. Craig Williams and Michael Van Lingen started off slowly but got some runs on board. It was JJ Smit down the order who made the difference with a 32-run cameo and David Wiese supported him well.

Just for a moment it looked like Namibia were going to crumble under pressure but they have kept their cool and have bagged their first ever win in the main draw of the T20 World Cup and also go on to win their third match on the bounce.
SIX! JJ Smit says enough is enough! He finishes things off in style! Shariff goes full and outside off, JJ Smit carves it over deep point for a maximum. NAMIBIA WIN BY 4 WICKETS!
Full again, outside off. Pikky Ya France again pushes it on the off side.
Full and on off, Pikky Ya France pushes it to short extra cover.
Pikky Ya France comes out to bat now.

OUT! CAUGHT! Would you believe it? A full toss outside off, Jan Frylinck could have hit that anywhere in the ground but smashes it straight to the mid-wicket fielder. Calum MacLeod takes the simplest of catches. Namibia fans will have to wait a few more minutes for the celebrations.
Commentary.Howout: c Calum MacLeod b Brad Wheal

Commentary.Commentary: On middle, pushed to mid on for a single. Scores level now!
FOUR! Nobody's running after that! Just 2 needed now. Fuller in length, on off. JJ Smit leans onto it and drives it through extra cover for a boundary.
Fuller in length, on off. Jan Frylinck drives it to left of the mid off fielder for a single.
Flatter ball, outside off Jan Frylinck hangs back and cuts it through cover-point for a single. 7 needed from 12 balls.
Short and on off, Jan Frylinck mistimes his pull to mid-wicket.
Jan Frylinck is in at number 7.

OUT! TAKEN! Excellent bowling from Michael Leask. Comes 'round the wicket and bowls it short and outside off, David Wiese chardges down the track and looks to go for another big shot. This time the ball goes off the outside edge towards short third man. Mark Watt moves to his left to grab the catch. Scotland aren't giving up without giving a fight.
Commentary.Howout: c Mark Watt b Michael Leask

Commentary.Commentary: On middle and leg, David Wiese looks to tuck it on the leg side but misses and gets hit on the thigh pad.
SIX! That will do for Namibia! Full and on off, David Wiese shimmies down the track and smacks it straight down the ground for a biggie. That will release some pressure off Wiese's shoulders.
Tosses it up, outside off. Punched towards covers.
That was close! Full and on leg, JJ Smit looks to smack it downtown but misses. That missed hitting the leg stump by a whisker. An excellent over from Mark Watt. Just 3 runs from it.
On off, pushed back to the bowler.
On leg, JJ Smit looks to clip it on the leg side. He misses and gets hit on the pads.
Loopy ball, on off. David Wiese pushes it through covers off the backfoot for a single.
Flatter ball, on off. JJ Smit looks to defend. The ball goes off the inside half to square leg for a single.
Full and on the pads, David Wiese nudges it to long on for one.
On off, Smit plays it back to the bowler.
Full and on middle. Smit clips it through mid-wicket for a couple.
Darted on the pads. Smit misses his flick. The ball takes the pads and rolls out.
Loopy ball, full and on off. Smit defends it out solidly.
SIX! BANG! Full toss and on off. Smit stays back and smokes it over the mid-wicket fence for a biggie. Namibia's game to lose hereon!
Flatter and on off. Smit whips across the line and works it to mid-wicket.
Full and on the pads. Smit flick it to short fine leg for another single. 25 needed in 30 balls.
Good length and outside off. Smit hangs back and looks to cut it away but misses.
WIDE! A length ball, down leg. Smit misses his flick. Wide called.
Full and on off. Wiese works it to long on for a single.
A couple more now! Touch short and on off. David Wiese pulls it to deep square leg. Brad Wheal does well in the deep to stop the boundary. The batters take two runs.
A length ball, around middle and leg. Smit clips it to the leg side for a single.
FOUR! Good-looking shot! Smit is on the charge straightaway. A length ball, outside off. Smit hangs back and punches it through point for a boundary.
Safyaan Sharif (2-0-5-1) is back into the attack.
Flatter and short, on off. Smit stays back and pulls it through mid-wicket. He gets a single this time.
On off. Smit whips it to mid-wicket but straight to the fielder.
Tossed up, on off. Smit prods and pushes it towards backward point for a couple.
Floated, full and on off. Smit plays it back to the bowler.
Full and on middle. Wiese chases it. The ball takes the inside edge and goes towards fine leg. They take one.
Short and outside off. Wiese looks to chase it but misses.
On the pads, flicked through square leg for a brace.
Short and outside off. Wiese cuts it through point for a single.
Floated, full and on off. Smit pushes it to cover for a single.
JJ Smit is the new batsman in.

OUT! STUMPED! Matt gets his first wicket. Mark Watt bowls down the leg yet again and this time it is fruitful. Scotland get their fourth wicket. Full and down leg. Williams comes down the track but misses his flick. The keeper goes to his left collects the ball and is quick to whip the bails to get rid of Williams. The umpire takes it upstairs to confirm if it was caught behind. The UltraEdge shows the bat was absent and the stumping was a neat one.
Commentary.Howout: st Matthew Cross b Mark Watt

Commentary.Commentary: Full and outside off. Williams slashes it through covers for a brace.
Full and on middle. Williams comes down and tucks it to the leg side.
A touch shorter, on leg stump. David Wiese goes on the back foot and tucks it behind square on the leg side for an easy two.
Flatter one, on off and Wiese taps it back onto the deck.
On the pads and this is flicked behind square for a single.
Tossed up, on leg stump. Wiese drives it past mid on for a single.
David Wiese comes out at number 5.

OUT! BOWLED! What a ripper from Michael Leask! Leask slows this one up and flights it beautifully around middle and leg stump. Gerhard Erasmus is completely beaten in flight as he strides forward to play at it. The ball goes between bat and pad and clips the top of leg stump. The skipper has to depart and Michael Leask is absolutely ecstatic.
Michael Leask comes into the attack now.
Shorter one, on off. Williams goes deep in his crease to pull it towards long off for a single.
Misfield and they get two runs. Around off and this is punched off the back foot by Erasmus towards point where the fielder makes a half stop. The batters take two off the misfield. Good running.
A touch short and wide, cut away through cover for a single.
Can't get it through. A low full toss, on off and Craig Williams strokes it straight to cover.
Flatter one, angled into middle stump. Williams keeps it out.
Quicker one, on off and Gerhard Erasmus dabs it down towards short third man for a quick single.
On middle and blocked out by Erasmus.
A touch short, around off. Erasmus cuts it off the back foot towards cover for a run.
Fullish ball, on middle and leg and this one skids on. Williams tickles it behind and the fielder dives in to his right at short fine leg to save the boundary. Just the single taken.
LEG BYE! Sliding down the leg side, Erasmus looks to dab it down but the ball comes off his pads and goes towards short fine leg. They take a leg bye.
Fullish ball, around off. Williams steps out of the crease and eases it down to long off for a single.
Shortish ball, angled in on middle. Williams punches it off the back foot through cover for a couple of runs.

DRINKS! With that wicket, the umpire decides to take on drinks. Namibia were off to a sedate start but have done well to keep the scoreboard ticking. Though they have lost 2 wickets, the required run rate is under 6 and will look to cruise through. Scotland will need to pick up more wickets to help their cause. Gerhard Erasmus walks out to bat now.

OUT! TAKEN! George Munsey takes a brilliant catch. Chris Greaves bowls another googly, around off stump and Zane Green doesn't pick it up. Green dances down the track looking to go downtown but ends up splicing it high and over extra cover. George Munsey races in from the deep and puts in the dive to pouch it. Chris Greaves has his man and can Scotland build on this wicket?
Commentary.Howout: c George Munsey b Chris Greaves

Commentary.Commentary: SIX! Craig Williams decides its time to step on the gas. Watt tosses this up, on off and Williams just skips down the track to lift it over the long on fence for a biggie.
LEG BYE! Slowed up, around leg stump. Zane Green looks to tuck it away but the ball goes off the pads on the leg side. They take a leg bye.
WIDE! Spilled way down the leg side. Wided.

What an effort in the deep, definitely two runs saved. On middle and Green slog-sweeps it towards the cow corner fence. The fielder runs in from long on and slides in to cut it off, keeping it to a couple.
Flatter one, on middle and Green flicks it straight to square leg.

Scotland have taken a review for an LBW. Ultra Edge shows there is a flat line as the ball passes the bat. Ball Tracking shows the ball is pitching outside leg. The original decision stays and Scotland lose a review.

NOT OUT! Slightly fuller, around leg stump. Zane Green gets on one knee to sweep it away but misses and gets rapped on the back leg. The Scots appeal but the umpire is unmoved. Richie Berrington does take the review but the Ball Tracker shows that the ball is pitching outside leg.
Mark Watt to operate now.
Almost carried that one. On a length, on middle. Green looks to get it away on the leg side but gets a leading edge just short of the bowler.

Floated, full and on leg. Williams looks to flick it away but misses. He gets rapped on the pads. Greaves appeals but the umpire is unmoved. Richie Berrington the stand-in skipper has a long chat with the players but decides to go against the review in the end.
Full and on leg. Williams makes room and looks to push it to the off side but gets an inside edge and the ball rolls out.

TWO LEG BYES! Floated, around middle. Williams comes down the track and looks to flick it away but misses. The ball takes the pads and goes past the keeper towards third man. The batters run two and umpire signals it as leg byes.
Flatter and on off. Green cuts it towards point and gets a single.
Floated, full and on off. Green looks to sweep it away. He gets an inside edge and ball rolls to the right of the keeper.
FOUR! Nicely played! Green gets his first boundary of the chase. Full and on off. Green comes across and scoops it towards fine leg and bags a boundary.
Chris Greaves is brought into the attack now.
On a length, on off. Green defends it to square on the off side. The batters cross for a quick single.
Full and on off. Green defends it out. Craig Williams wanted a single but was sent back by Green. The fielder has a throw at the bowler's end but misses. A direct hit could have been interesting!
Another single for Williams. Good length and on middle. Williams stays back and pushes it to point for a run.
Short, around middle and leg. Green pulls it through square leg for a single.
Length and on off. Green pushes it to cover.
Fuller and on off. Williams stays back and pushes it through cover-point for a single.
Brad Wheal (2-0-4-0) is brought back into the attack.
On a length, around off. Williams comes down the track and punches it past extra cover. The batters pick a single. At the end of Powerplay, Namibia are at 29/1.
Touch short and outside off. Williams looks to cut it away. The ball takes the inner half and ends up back to the bowler.
A dot to follow the wicket! Length and on off. Williams pushes it to covers with an angled bat.
Zane Green is in at number 3.

OUT! CAUGHT! Safyaan Sharif draws the first blood. He gets a wicket to his name. A length ball, on off. Michael Van Lingen looks to heave it across the line, but is a bit early in his shot. The ball goes off the leading edge and balloons towards cover. Richie Berrington settles under it and takes an easy catch. The bowlers will aim to build on this wicket now.
Commentary.Howout: c Richie Berrington b Safyaan Sharif

Commentary.Commentary: Another single now! Williams is still finding his rhythm. Tad short and on off. Williams pulls it through mid-wicket for a single.
Sharif hurls in a length ball, on off. Van Lingen tucks it to the leg side for a single.
Full and on off. Michael Van Lingen pushes it to mid off for a single. Josh Davey has been a tad expensive in his second over. 10 runs coming from the over.
FOUR! Back-to-back boundaries. Michael Van Lingen is on the charge now. A length ball, on off. Michael Van Lingen drills it past mid on for a boundary.
FOUR! Top Shot. Michael Van Lingen gets the first boundary of the chase. That should break the shackles. Touch short and on off. Michael Van Lingen pulls it over mid-wicket and bags a boundary.
SWING AND A MISS! A length ball, outside off. Michael Van Lingen comes down the track and looks to heave it away but misses.
Davey comes around the wicket now. On a length, around off. Michael Van Lingen pushes it to cover.
A length ball, outside off. Williams swings his blade at it. The ball takes the outside edge and goes towards deep backward point. They take one.
Josh Davey (1-0-5-0) to bowl from the opposite end now.
Good-length ball, attacking the stumps. Michael Van Lingen defends it back to the bowler.
On a length, around off. Michael Van Lingen pushes it to extra cover.

Good-length ball, on off. Craig Williams taps it to point. Michael Van Lingen sets off for a single but is sent back by his partner. He is halfway down the track. The fielder has a shy at the bowler's end but misses. The batters eventually takes a single off overthrows. Replay shows that had that hit the stumps, Michael Van Lingen was a goner.
On a length, on leg. Michael Van Lingen looks to pull but misses. He gets hit on the thigh pad. Safyaan Sharif appeals for an LBW but the umpire is unmoved. The batters take a leg bye.
Short of a length, on middle, at 125 kph. Craig Williams hops and tucks it to square leg for a run.
On a length, on off. Craig Williams defends it on the off side.
Here comes the first bowling change. Safyaan Sharif comes on to bowl.
Outside off, steered towards point. Excllent bowling from Brad Wheal. Just 2 runs from it.
Good-length ball, around off, at 134 kph. Michael Van Lingen looks to drive but gets beaten by the inward movement.
On a good length, outside off. Michael Van Lingen punches it off the backfoot through covers for a couple of runs.
On a length, on leg. Michael Van Lingen tries to clip it on the leg side but gets rapped on the pads once again.
On a length, on leg. Michael Van Lingen looks to work it on the leg side. Gets an inside edge back onto the pads.
Short of a length, on off. Pulled to mid-wicket. The fielder moves to his right to stop the ball.
Crunched but straight to the fielder! Good-length ball, outside off. Craig Williams slaps it on the backfoot but straight to the fielder at covers.
Touch fuller, on middle. Michael Van Lingen knocks it in front of mid on for a run.
Two again! On a good length, outside off, at 128 kph. Michael Van Lingen steers it to deep point for a brace.
On a length, on middle. Michael Van Lingen tucks it to deep backward square leg for a couple of runs.
Overpitched delivery, on middle. Michael Van Lingen drills it to mid on.
Good line and length from Josh Davey! Around off, swinging away, Michael Van Lingen looks to push it on the off side. The ball whizzes past the outside edge.
Josh Davey to steam in from the opposite end.
Good-length ball, around off, shaping away from the batter, at 130 kph. Craig Williams prods and looks to defend. The ball zips past the outside edge. 6 runs from the first over.
Good-length ball, on middle. Craig Williams defends it on the off side.
Nearly dragged on! Length ball outside off, Michael Van Lingen looks to drive. The ball goes off the inside edge past the stumps to short fine leg. A single is taken.
Fuller in length, on middle. Michael Van Lingen pushes it back to the bowler.

FOUR LEG BYES! Namibia got the start they wanted with the ball and have now got a start with the bat as well. This is bowled full and on leg, Michael Van Lingen looks to flick but misses. The ball goes off the pads and races away to the fine leg fence.
Brad Wheal starts with a short of a length, on middle. Craig Williams hops and drops the ball on the leg side. He takes a single. Namibia and Craig Williams are underway!
